attributes.board_name: Hawaii Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs – Occupational Therapy Program (PVL)

rules.notes: No continuing education is listed as a renewal condition: the program's renewal information and the renewal statute (HRS §457G-6) require only the biennial fee by December 31 of each even-numbered year. Current period Jan 1, 2027 – Dec 31, 2028; renewals accepted Nov 9 – Dec 31, 2026; $186 active OT or OTA. Forfeited licenses may be restored within 1 year ($261).
